author: andyjohn231
body: I will admit, I was hacking, but if I have to turn my hacks off to get unbanned then ill make sure every time I join the avicus I am using 1.8.8 or 1.8.9. If I get caught using hacks again then I will take full responsibility and stay banned.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Im afraid that because you were banned so recently, and that evidence does stand. You will not be appealed. Please appeal in 5-8 months.

This appeal has been Denied.

Thanks,
Iron Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
